title: Wooden Wedding Guest Book, 3D Cutout Love Tree Photo Album, Wedding Day Memory Scrapbook With Birdcage Photo Frame, Wedding Party Keepsake Sign In Book
body_html:
Exquisite 3D Laser Cut Wooden Design: Features layered hollow love tree, raised LOVE letter decor, hanging heart pendants and a mini birdcage photo slot, paired with delicate "Wedding Day" lettering to create a romantic vintage wedding aesthetic.
Premium Natural Wood Material: Crafted from lightweight smooth log wood with burr-free cutting edges, eco-friendly and sturdy, not easy to deform or fade, long-lasting to preserve your precious wedding memories.
Dual Function as Guest Book & Photo Album: Equipped with metal ring binding for easy page replacement; guests can leave signatures, blessings and messages inside, while the built-in photo frame lets you display your favorite wedding couple snapshot.
Perfect All-Round Wedding Keepsake: Ideal for wedding ceremonies, bridal showers, engagement parties and anniversary celebrations, serving as a sentimental souvenir to record warm wishes from family and friends.
Unique Gift Choice for Couples: Elegant rustic wooden appearance makes it a thoughtful present for newlyweds, brides and grooms, helping them collect heartfelt memories to look back on for years to come.


If you need a single custom item, you must purchase both the quantity option and the single custom option at the same time.


This product supports personal customization. If you need customization, please purchase the custom option and leave your custom requirements in the order notes. Orders without custom notes will be shipped with the standard version .
Product Includes:
2 wooden covers + 20 sheets of 250g kraft paper (40 writing pages) + 2 vintage brass ring binders
Product Name:
Personalized Wooden Wedding Guest Book, Wedding Photo Album Gift
Dimensions:
28×20×1.6 CM
Packaging:
OPP bag + outer paper box
Total Packed Weight:
430 grams (20 kraft paper sheets / 40 usable pages)
Compatible Photo Size:
4-inch photos (4 × 3.5 inches)
Minor note correction:
The original "4*3.5CM" is logically a typo (4cm photo is too tiny for the birdcage frame), so translated as inches, which matches standard 4-inch wedding photos. If you strictly need centimeter wording, replace the last line with:
Compatible Photo Size: 4-inch, 4 × 3.5 CM
